claims.claim_text: The 5-year survival rate is less than 10%, even in developed countries such as the USA.
autophagy plays a positive role for attenuating CuSO4-induced testicular damage and spermatogenesis disorder.
ATO promoted autophagy in the aorta of ApoE-/- mice and reduced atherosclerotic lesions in early AS
We identified miR-155 as a mediator of alcohol-related regulation of autophagy and exosome production in hepatocytes and macrophages.
HIF-1α-induced expression of m6A reader YTHDF1 drives hypoxia-induced autophagy and malignancy of hepatocellular carcinoma by promoting ATG2A and ATG14 translation
PolyI:C into the cytoplasm, or Sendai virus infection, significantly induced autophagy in normal cells but not in RIG-I-deficient cells.
Berberine represses human gastric cancer cell growth in vitro and in vivo by inducing cytostatic autophagy via inhibition of MAPK/mTOR/p70S6K and Akt signaling pathways
inhibition of autophagy could suppress CuSO4-induced ferroptosis in in vivo and vitro.
Inhibition of autophagy could decrease cell viability, and enhance the ROS accumulation and apoptosis in the GC-1 cells.
oxidative stress inhibitor (NAC) attenuated CuSO4-induced autophagy in vivo and vitro, reversing the activation for AMPK-mTOR pathway.
co-treatment with the apoptosis inhibitor (Z-VAD-FMK) could decrease the spermatogenesis disorder but not influence autophagy.
CuSO4 could induce autophagy via AMPK-mTOR pathway that downregulated p-mTOR/mTOR and subsequently upregulated p-AMPKα/AMPKα as well as p-ULK1/ULK1.
ATO triggered the nuclear translocation of TFEB, which in turn promoted autophagy and autophagosome-lysosome fusion
ATO-induced activation of autophagy was an earlier event than ATO-induced inhibition of the expression of apoptosis markers
PI3K inhibitor (LY294002) and mTOR inhibitor (rapamycin) cooperated with ATO to induce autophagy
Autophagy-activated Schwann cells promote PNI through enhanced migration and axon guidance toward PanCa cells and increased chemoattraction
alcohol disrupted autophagy function at the lysosomal level through decreased LAMP1 and LAMP2 in livers with ALD.
We found impaired autophagy both in ALD and alcoholic hepatitis (AH) mouse models and human livers with ALD as indicated by increased hepatic p62 and LC3-II levels.
Alcohol reduced autophagy flux in vivo in chloroquine-treated mice as well as in vitro in hepatocytes and macrophages treated with bafilomycin A.
miR-155-deficient mice were protected from alcohol-induced disruption of autophagy and showed attenuated exosome production.
Ablation of Atg7 from kidney proximal tubules led to autophagy deficiency and worse renal hypertrophy, tubular damage, inflammation, fibrosis, and albuminuria in diabetic mice
blockade of p53 attenuated miR-214 induction in DKD, leading to higher levels of ULK1 and autophagy, accompanied by an amelioration of DKD
renal biopsies from patients with diabetes showed induction of p53 and miR-214, associated with downregulation of ULK1 and autophagy
Ablation of miR-214 from kidney proximal tubules prevented a decrease in ULK1 expression and autophagy impairment in diabetic kidneys, resulting in less renal hypertrophy and albuminuria
YTHDF1 deficiency inhibited HCC autophagy, growth, and metastasis.
YTHDF1 contributed to the translation of autophagy-related genes ATG2A and ATG14 by binding to m6A-modified ATG2A and ATG14 mRNA.
PolyI:C transfection or Sendai virus infection induced autophagy in the cells lacking type-I interferon signaling.
RIG-I-mediated autophagy diminished by the deficiency of mitochondrial antiviral signaling protein (MAVS) or TRAF6.
In xenografts, the berberine induced autophagy leads to suppression of tumor proliferation with no side-effect.
Berberine triggered cell autophagy, demonstrated by monodansylcadaverine staining, GFP-LC3, LC3-II, Beclin-1, p-ULK1 promotion, and p62 degradation.
Autophagy can degrade MHC-I to mediate immune evasion and also regulates polarization of macrophages in the tumor microenvironment.
Protective autophagy stimulates drug resistance and gemcitabine resistance in PC cells, and its inhibition can enhance radiosensitivity.
Starvation and hypoxia can stimulate glycolysis, and glycolysis induction can be mediated by autophagy in enhancing tumorigenesis in PC.
Supportive autophagy in PC escalates the growth rate of PC cells and its suppression can mediate cell death.
Autophagy determines the metastasis of PC cells, and it can control the EMT in affecting migration.
The induction of autophagy by the RIG-I pathway might also contribute to preventing an excessive interferon response as a negative-feedback mechanism.
Exposing fibroblasts to ROS scavengers decreased ROS production during SS, inhibited autophagy, and significantly reduced the expression of senescence and myofibroblast differentiation markers.
Modulation of autophagy activity is provided by silibinin, ursolic acid, chrysin and huaier in the treatment of PC.
